pass: static, then web preview at 390x844 (headless Edge)

findings.summary: Recipe and account were flat text with the same card treatment as tappable drinks
Ingredient chips and the back control were under 44pt
Empty lists were a single muted sentence with no way forward
Conta used placeholder-as-label
Press feedback was an opacity flash
Drink lists used ScrollView over a catalog that sync can grow
Buscar and Favoritos were a stack of identical cards for plain navigation rows
Identificar results sat below 29 chips with no way to reach them without scrolling blind
Back control used the accent, which the spec reserves for primary action, active tab and active favorite
Non-alcoholic drinks showed 'Sem álcool' twice (category and badge)
Recipe doses were numbers only; the spec's amber-as-liquid idea had no visual
Buscar rows repeated 'Clássico' on 11 of 14 lines and said nothing about what is in the drink; rows now carry the ingredient line and the category became the section header
Uppercase letter-spaced eyebrows (BRASILEIRO, INGREDIENTES, PREPARO) were the dark-editorial template rhythm; replaced by sentence-case heads with a muted count
Recipe spent ~80pt on a sticky full-width pink pill for favoriting; favorite moved to the top bar and the footer removed
Preparo used a generic circle-and-rail stepper; now hanging numerals with hairlines
Spec 4.8 requires 'Sem álcool' in amber; it rendered in textMuted
Identificar group counts were amber badge circles; now plain '1 de 11' text in amber
Camera notice was a 90pt dashed box above the chips; now a one-line caption
Empty states ended in a full-width pink pill; search empty now explains the fold rule and points to Identificar, favorites empty says how the list fills
Password rule only appeared after an error, and 'Criar conta' had the same weight as 'Entrar'
Sync error rendered 'Não sincronizado' twice (title plus stored message)
Coverage percent was 14pt label text; now the measure role with tabular figures

dismissed: Tell 27: drink back is the only back affordance; the stack header stays hidden so the title is not repeated.
Tell 26: Conta keeps auth on the tab because the spec is browse-first.
Tell 5: the selection tray has shadowColor with a sibling elevation.
Thumb zone: the recipe favorite sits top-right, the iOS convention for a secondary action on a reading screen (Music, Podcasts).
Light mode: out of this version; tokens are dark-only.
Skeletons and pull-to-refresh: the first paint waits on the splash, and lists read SQLite.
unverified: software keyboard on iOS and Android
1.3x font scale on the tab bar, the tray and the recipe top bar
splash to first screen on a device
sticky section headers in Buscar on iOS and Android
knownPlatformIssues: Web only: expo-sqlite's synchronous write can throw 'Sync operation timeout' when the worker is slow on a cold bundle; the favorite is still written. Seen again on the first run of this pass, not on the second.
lint: expo lint was not configured before this pass; it installed eslint-config-expo and reports 1 error and 1 warning in files this pass did not touch (src/supabase/client.ts dynamic env access, src/db/client.ts Array<T>).
